sentences.text: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Medical Assistance for Incurable Diseases

**Scheme Brief Description:** “Medical Assistance for Incurable Diseases” under the “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” by the Labour Resources Dept., provides financial assistance ranging from ₹7,500/- to ₹30,000/- to workers or craftsmen suffering from incurable diseases.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Health & Wellness; Sector: Financial assistance

**Detailed Description:** The “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” launched by the Labour Resources Department, Bihar, aims to provide social security through various types of financial assistance to workers and artisans in the unorganized sector. <br>

**Benefits / Assistance:** - **Financial Assistance:** ₹7,500/- to ₹30,000/- (for detailed view refer to Page no. 7 of the scheme [Guidelines](https://state.bihar.gov.in/labour/cache/40/14-May-21/SHOW_DOCS/Schemes-1.pdf)) <br> <br>

**Application Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the concerned office of the District Officer or Committee. **Step 2:** Collect the application form; fill in and attach all the mandatory documents (attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the complete application to the concerned District Officer or Labour Welfare Committee at the address below. > **Office Address:** > Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar > Bihar State Labour Welfare Committee > Niyojan Bhawan, Patna- 800 007 > Tel: 062-2520 053 > Email-edbslws2017@gmail.com
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Labour Resources Department
**Tags:** Social Security, Unorganised Worker, Craftsmen, Incurable Diseases, Medical Assistance
